scope: Independent source and control-hash review only; no compiler/Python/browser/import execution.
findings: Fetched and inspected all four exact tooling Git blobs plus frozen manifest. Sparse checkout contains the complete ESM dependency chain, package.json, both checked native modules, and all 14 C/header inputs. The stock builder requires Node built-ins only.

Stock --check verifies both targets against manifest SHA and WebAssembly.validate. The separately retained stripped parser command matches stock compiler/linker/target argv/source order except output path, and must reproduce the complete traced parser bytes before names are considered.

Named parser differs only by removal of the single -Wl,--strip-all argument. Ordered raw noncustom sections, including section ID/length bytes, must match the valid traced parser exactly. No-import admission and matching function/code counts preserve zero-based function-index alignment.

Name parser rejects malformed section bounds, invalid UTF-8, repeated name sections/function-name subsections, duplicate/out-of-range/empty names and trailing name-map bytes. It leaves any absent name null rather than inventing attribution.

Downloaded input run/head/attempt/completion, artifact identity/name/size/digest and analysis JSON hash are bound. Reused helper verifies endpoint, HTTPS redirect without forwarding GitHub token, download length/SHA and safe unique ZIP paths.

Symbolization checks exact sampled module SHA and copies original function index, sample count, adjacent elapsed weight and ancestor data without reweighting. It is not CPU-time attribution or a new import.

Workflow runs seven authored deterministic tests before source recovery, records failures, uses pinned actions/Node and exact compiler/linker versions, and retains controls/binaries/commands/parity/source snapshots even on failure.

limits: Names identify surviving emitted functions; they do not recover inlined C locations or per-instruction line attribution.
Removing strip-all is accepted only after exact noncustom parity, not because compiler/source versions match.
Missing sampled function names may remain null; source review does not promise recovery coverage.
The prior trace's timed-import window is not established; original counts and weights remain diagnostic and are not a speedup ceiling.
No production refs/source, acquisition protocol, or measurement results were changed.
